title: Constraint: Unique Row Maximums
constraints: `m` is a 4 × 4 byte matrix. Let rowmax(i) be the largest element of row i. Then rowmax(0) < rowmax(1) < rowmax(2) < rowmax(3).
Runs on Verilator with the z3 solver (`sudo pacman -S z3`).
hints: "max of a row" isn't a constraint primitive. Introduce helper variables `rand bit [7:0] mx[4];`.
Pin each helper to its row's maximum: every element ≤ mx[i], and at least one element == mx[i].
